title: Orny Adams
description: Orny Adams first rose to fame after co-starring in Jerry Seinfeld's documentary "Comedian." He has made several appearances on The Tonight Show with Jay Leno and has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman. In 2010, Orny followed up his critically acclaimed debut comedy DVD/CD "Path Of Most Resistance," with a powerful and poignant one hour special "Orny Adams Takes The Third" which aired on Comedy Central. And in 2011, Orny can be seen on MTV's "Teen Wolf," a one hour drama created by Criminal Mind's Jeff Davis. When not performing stand-up, Orny spends his days writing, penning scripts, and developing television shows. A few years back, he struck a deal with Endimol for "The Pitch," a reality show he conceived. But none of this matters until you see Orny live where he is at his best, deconstructing the chaos of the modern world and getting worked up about things that most people just accept. Orny's comedy style is unique, yet universally appealing. He's quick on his feet to deliver a powerful, clever, sophisticated, and fast-paced routine that attacks topics from an angle that most people never consider.

description: This darkly comic play follows Julia (a rebellious Stanford graduate student researching her thesis) and Danny (a hitchhiking teenaged runaway she picks up) as together they retrace novelist and lepidopterist Vladimir Nabokov's actual 1941 roadtrip from New York to Stanford. description:

2006 Cain Concept "The Benchland" - originating from the classical 'benchlands' of Napa Valley on the eastern and western benches of Oakville, Rutherford and St. Helena. This wine has Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot for a strong backbone, along with Cabernet Franc for the nose and a touch of Merlot for a layer of velvet. Able to stand up to any steak, most notably the Tomahawk Rib Chop!

NV7 Cain Cuvee - a more sleek and approachable wine with fresh vibrancy, the NV Cain Cuvee is immediately delicious while showing great aging potential. Cabernet Franc contributes to the aromatic top, while the Merlot component lays down a silky base. We recommend pairing this with our Bone-In Filet.

2002 Cain Concept "Library Edition" - this Cabernet Sauvignon based blend embodies lush fruit and supple tannins. It is ripe, plummy, rich and dusty, reflecting a long, warm summer in the Oakville and Rutherford districts of Napa Valley. Taste this with our Kansas City Bone-In New York Steak for perfect pairing.

2005 Cain Five - a true Bordeaux Blend with Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Expected to age gracefully for a long time, this wine opens well in the glass. With a fine touch of tannins and a focus on red cherries and exotic spices, this wine is a true gem. 22 months in barrel. Try it paired with our Wagyu Kobe Beef.

-------------------------------------------------------

Each one of these wines are distinct and delicious, complementing our Bone-In Steaks perfectly. Ask for a pairing recommendation or enjoy by itself!

description: Note to Robert Fripp fans: It's Stephen King's "Crimson King" to which the band's name refers. This royal is apparently the villain character from those dismayingly thick-looking Dark Tower books. They are not referring to the old-school hackles raised by Barry Godber's album cover for King Crimson. (Godner died at age 24 after doing that painting, perhaps of residual horror.) Metalheads AHTCK, a big cut above the pay-for-play musical poodles of Sunset Boulevard, come out of the fracked-beyond-recognition desert wasteland down south. description: Death Angel originally emerged from the '80s Bay Area thrash scene -- the same toxic stew that spawned Exodus, Testament, Possessed and, well, you know who else -- but disbanded in 1990 after a horrific bus accident. title: Robert Mapplethorpe: Portraits
description:
Robert Mapplethorpe had an eye for classical balance and perfection, whether photographing still lifes, the human figure, or the portraits that, perhaps surprisingly, make up earliest and the largest part of his oeuvre. In this first comprehensive overview of Mapplethorpe's portraiture since the artist's death at the age of 42, over twenty years ago, we see a side of Mapplethorpe quite different from that of the notorious controversy that surrounded his homoerotic nudes. Carefully composed, Mapplethorpe's portraits reveal his highly refined sense of beauty and monumentality. At once timelessly elegant and strikingly intense, Mapplethorpe's portraits -- made both of his own initiative and on commission -- bring to life the legendary cultural scene of New York in the late 1970s and 1980s and document several generations of influential creative personalities, from grande dame artist Louise Nevelson to punk poet and musician Patti Smith.

This exhibition presents exquisite black-and-white photographs of nearly one hundred artists, art dealers, writers, musicians, designers, dancers, actors, and actresses -- many of whom changed the course of literature, visual art, and music. Included are William Burroughs, Truman Capote, Glenn Close, Marianne Faithfull, Richard Gere, Keith Haring, David Hockney, Grace Jones, Lisette Model, Alice Neel, Yoko Ono, Paloma Picasso, Iggy Pop, Isabella Rossellini, Ed Ruscha, Arnold Schwarzenegger, and Andy Warhol. Many of the images are on loan from the Robert Mapplethorpe Foundation, New York.

Guest curator Gordon Baldwin notes that these portraits document a key moment in New York life and in the LGBT community: "Mapplethorpe's [portraits] are representative of New York at a particularly vibrant, prosperous, and expansive moment in its history, when it was the undisputed center of the art world, and before it experienced the full impact of the AIDS epidemic." This exhibition and the accompanying catalogue reveal Mapplethorpe's contribution to the history of photography and the evolution of the modern portrait.

This exhibition was organized by the Palm Springs Art Museum, Palm Springs, California, with the assistance of guest curator Gordon Baldwin. The exhibition is sponsored in part by the Helene and Lou Galen Exhibition Fund and the Faye and Herman Sarkowsky Exhibition Fund.

Sponsored by the SJMA Store Guild.

We would not see any other material until 2004's comeback CD, The Art of Dying, and its follow-up, 2008's Killing Season. While purists continue to crave nothing but old-school thrash, Death Angel thrives on variety. They like to mix up the riffs and get sideways. They have no problem playing the older, more brutal material right alongside their recent work, which seems more like straight-up early Maiden-influenced metal rather than speedy, murderous, violent thrash. - Gary Singh sanjose.com

title: Galileo's Daughters
description: Philosophical questions of no small consequence are addressed in this contemplative and visually and aesthetically stunning play. Is science part of God's plan? Or does the power of science lie in its ability to explain away God's existence over time? Scientific inquiry and discovery, on the one hand, and faith and devotion on the other collide in the life and work of Galileo. The setting is Florence and Rome from 1630 to 1635. Galileo has moved near his daughters and strives to support their convent as best he can. Sister Arcangela has developed a mystic relationship to the Holy Scripture, while Sister Celeste avidly follows her father's scientific discoveries and helps him in any way she can by reading and recopying his manuscripts as his eyesight begins to fail him. More is actually known about Celeste, through the survival of over 120 of her letters to her father, an endearing correspondence cited throughout the play. The audience learns of the family's early life through a series of flashbacks. Galileo must remind his daughters that it has become too dangerous to "sing the truth" as they did when they were children. The scene changes as the two sisters are transformed into Inquisitors interrogating Galileo and his convictions. Finally, the action moves back to a time when Galileo's daughters joyfully share the "truth" with their father as they first look at the heavens through one of his telescopic inventions.

title: Galileo's Daughters
description: Philosophical questions of no small consequence are addressed in this contemplative and visually and aesthetically stunning play. Is science part of God's plan? Or does the power of science lie in its ability to explain away God's existence over time? Scientific inquiry and discovery, on the one hand, and faith and devotion on the other collide in the life and work of Galileo. The setting is Florence and Rome from 1630 to 1635. Galileo has moved near his daughters and strives to support their convent as best he can. Sister Arcangela has developed a mystic relationship to the Holy Scripture, while Sister Celeste avidly follows her father's scientific discoveries and helps him in any way she can by reading and recopying his manuscripts as his eyesight begins to fail him. More is actually known about Celeste, through the survival of over 120 of her letters to her father, an endearing correspondence cited throughout the play. The audience learns of the family's early life through a series of flashbacks. Galileo must remind his daughters that it has become too dangerous to "sing the truth" as they did when they were children. The scene changes as the two sisters are transformed into Inquisitors interrogating Galileo and his convictions. Finally, the action moves back to a time when Galileo's daughters joyfully share the "truth" with their father as they first look at the heavens through one of his telescopic inventions.

title: Spectrum
description: Few alternative acts were as polarizing as Spacemen 3 in the college-rock explosion of the '80s. They wrote pop gems and then buried them in waves of psychedelic distortion. But they imploded fairly quickly, with guitarist and vocalist Pete Kember (better known as Sonic Boom) going on to several other projects, including Experimental Audio Research with Kevin Shields from My Bloody Valentine. Spectrum, in some ways, realized Kember's potential for making gorgeous tunes, unburdened by impenetrable sonic haze (though there is still gobs of reverb). In particular, covers of Beat Happening's "Indian Summer" (also covered by fellow effects-pedal-worshippers Luna) and Daniel Johnston's "True Love Will Find You in the End" linked Kember's sound to the indie canon and made it seem, for once, a little more down to Earth. - Steve Palopoli sanjose.com

title: Spectrum
description: Few alternative acts were as polarizing as Spacemen 3 in the college-rock explosion of the '80s. They wrote pop gems and then buried them in waves of psychedelic distortion. But they imploded fairly quickly, with guitarist and vocalist Pete Kember (better known as Sonic Boom) going on to several other projects, including Experimental Audio Research with Kevin Shields from My Bloody Valentine. Spectrum, in some ways, realized Kember's potential for making gorgeous tunes, unburdened by impenetrable sonic haze (though there is still gobs of reverb). In particular, covers of Beat Happening's "Indian Summer" (also covered by fellow effects-pedal-worshippers Luna) and Daniel Johnston's "True Love Will Find You in the End" linked Kember's sound to the indie canon and made it seem, for once, a little more down to Earth. - Steve Palopoli sanjose.com

description:
Take advantage of some great wine deals over the next two months at The Grill on the Alley in downtown San Jose. Highlighting a variety of wines from the reputable Cain Vineyard & Winery, enjoy 4 different wines in our bar, dining room and patio area. This promotion will run for 2 months and feature the 2006 Cain Concept -'the Benchland' the NV7 Cain Cuvee, the 2002 Cain Concept - Library Edition, as well as the 2005 Cain Five - a true Bordeaux Blend!

-------------------------------------------------------
2006 Cain Concept "The Benchland" - originating from the classical 'benchlands' of Napa Valley on the eastern and western benches of Oakville, Rutherford and St. Helena. This wine has Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot for a strong backbone, along with Cabernet Franc for the nose and a touch of Merlot for a layer of velvet. Able to stand up to any steak, most notably the Tomahawk Rib Chop!

NV7 Cain Cuvee - a more sleek and approachable wine with fresh vibrancy, the NV Cain Cuvee is immediately delicious while showing great aging potential. Cabernet Franc contributes to the aromatic top, while the Merlot component lays down a silky base. We recommend pairing this with our Bone-In Filet.

2002 Cain Concept "Library Edition" - this Cabernet Sauvignon based blend embodies lush fruit and supple tannins. It is ripe, plummy, rich and dusty, reflecting a long, warm summer in the Oakville and Rutherford districts of Napa Valley. Taste this with our Kansas City Bone-In New York Steak for perfect pairing.

2005 Cain Five - a true Bordeaux Blend with Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Expected to age gracefully for a long time, this wine opens well in the glass. With a fine touch of tannins and a focus on red cherries and exotic spices, this wine is a true gem. 22 months in barrel. Try it paired with our Wagyu Kobe Beef.

-------------------------------------------------------

Each one of these wines are distinct and delicious, complementing our Bone-In Steaks perfectly. Ask for a pairing recommendation or enjoy by itself!

title: Robert Mapplethorpe: Portraits
description:
Robert Mapplethorpe had an eye for classical balance and perfection, whether photographing still lifes, the human figure, or the portraits that, perhaps surprisingly, make up earliest and the largest part of his oeuvre. In this first comprehensive overview of Mapplethorpe's portraiture since the artist's death at the age of 42, over twenty years ago, we see a side of Mapplethorpe quite different from that of the notorious controversy that surrounded his homoerotic nudes. Carefully composed, Mapplethorpe's portraits reveal his highly refined sense of beauty and monumentality. At once timelessly elegant and strikingly intense, Mapplethorpe's portraits -- made both of his own initiative and on commission -- bring to life the legendary cultural scene of New York in the late 1970s and 1980s and document several generations of influential creative personalities, from grande dame artist Louise Nevelson to punk poet and musician Patti Smith.

This exhibition presents exquisite black-and-white photographs of nearly one hundred artists, art dealers, writers, musicians, designers, dancers, actors, and actresses -- many of whom changed the course of literature, visual art, and music. Included are William Burroughs, Truman Capote, Glenn Close, Marianne Faithfull, Richard Gere, Keith Haring, David Hockney, Grace Jones, Lisette Model, Alice Neel, Yoko Ono, Paloma Picasso, Iggy Pop, Isabella Rossellini, Ed Ruscha, Arnold Schwarzenegger, and Andy Warhol. Many of the images are on loan from the Robert Mapplethorpe Foundation, New York.

Guest curator Gordon Baldwin notes that these portraits document a key moment in New York life and in the LGBT community: "Mapplethorpe's [portraits] are representative of New York at a particularly vibrant, prosperous, and expansive moment in its history, when it was the undisputed center of the art world, and before it experienced the full impact of the AIDS epidemic." This exhibition and the accompanying catalogue reveal Mapplethorpe's contribution to the history of photography and the evolution of the modern portrait.

This exhibition was organized by the Palm Springs Art Museum, Palm Springs, California, with the assistance of guest curator Gordon Baldwin. The exhibition is sponsored in part by the Helene and Lou Galen Exhibition Fund and the Faye and Herman Sarkowsky Exhibition Fund.

title: Limited Time Wine Specials
description:
Take advantage of some great wine deals over the next two months at The Grill on the Alley in downtown San Jose. Highlighting a variety of wines from the reputable Cain Vineyard & Winery, enjoy 4 different wines in our bar, dining room and patio area. This promotion will run for 2 months and feature the 2006 Cain Concept -'the Benchland' the NV7 Cain Cuvee, the 2002 Cain Concept - Library Edition, as well as the 2005 Cain Five - a true Bordeaux Blend!

-------------------------------------------------------
2006 Cain Concept "The Benchland" - originating from the classical 'benchlands' of Napa Valley on the eastern and western benches of Oakville, Rutherford and St. Helena. This wine has Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot for a strong backbone, along with Cabernet Franc for the nose and a touch of Merlot for a layer of velvet. Able to stand up to any steak, most notably the Tomahawk Rib Chop!

NV7 Cain Cuvee - a more sleek and approachable wine with fresh vibrancy, the NV Cain Cuvee is immediately delicious while showing great aging potential. Cabernet Franc contributes to the aromatic top, while the Merlot component lays down a silky base. We recommend pairing this with our Filet Mignon.

2002 Cain Concept "Library Edition" - this Cabernet Sauvignon based blend embodies lush fruit and supple tannins. It is ripe, plummy, rich and dusty, reflecting a long, warm summer in the Oakville and Rutherford districts of Napa Valley. Taste this with our Kansas City Bone-In New York Steak for perfect pairing.

2005 Cain Five - a true Bordeaux Blend with Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Expected to age gracefully for a long time, this wine opens well in the glass. With a fine touch of tannins and a focus on red cherries and exotic spices, this wine is a true gem. 22 months in barrel. Try it paired with our Tomahawk Rib Chop.

-------------------------------------------------------

Each one of these wines are distinct and delicious, complementing our Bone-In Steaks perfectly. Ask for a pairing recommendation or enjoy by itself!

title: 2011 Nature and Vision Quest
description:
A quest is an experience that everyone should undertake at least once in their lifetime. Quests are powerful practices that can provide deep peace, beauty, moments filled with meaning, and even profound guidance and insight. Many people around the world have benefited from immersing themselves in nature to seek wisdom, truth and beauty. Quests are wonderful ways to: Discover Inner Peace; Find Answers from the Heart; Experience Joy and Beauty; Connect deeply with Nature and living things; Face your fears and step into Courage; Deepen your meditation practice; Contemplate your life's purpose; Be at One with god/the creator/the universe, yourself.

The Northern California Quest will be held in the largest remaining protected area of wilderness in California, with over 87,000 acres of beautiful wild open spaces. The terrain of the park is rugged, varied, and beautiful, with lofty ridges and steep canyons. The park is now home to a fascinating variety of plants and animals.

About Your Quest Leader: Catriona MacGregor, J.D., M.S., R.M.A., is an internationally renowned environmentalist, nature guide and award winning author of "Partnering with Nature: The Wild Path to Reconnecting with the Earth." She has been a voice for animals and wild places all of her life. As a visionary bridge builder between nature and humankind and an adept nature guide and naturalist, she leads Vision Quests, nature tours, exclusive birding outings in the U.S. and internationally. She has worked in the following countries and regions: U.S., Mexico and Latin America, New Zealand & Australia, Scotland, South Pacific Islands, Bering Sea, Taiwan, South Pacific, China, Japan, and Alaska. Catriona's work has been covered in Time Magazine, Sports Illustrated, NPR Radio, and the Today Show. Catriona is the coauthor of "Healing the Heart of the World: Harnessing the Power of Intention to Change Your Life and the Planet," along with Carolyn Myss, Jean Shinoda Bolen, Masaru Emoto, Fritjof Capra, Thich Nhat Hanh, et al..

title: Robert Mapplethorpe: Portraits
description:
Robert Mapplethorpe had an eye for classical balance and perfection, whether photographing still lifes, the human figure, or the portraits that, perhaps surprisingly, make up earliest and the largest part of his oeuvre. In this first comprehensive overview of Mapplethorpe's portraiture since the artist's death at the age of 42, over twenty years ago, we see a side of Mapplethorpe quite different from that of the notorious controversy that surrounded his homoerotic nudes. Carefully composed, Mapplethorpe's portraits reveal his highly refined sense of beauty and monumentality. At once timelessly elegant and strikingly intense, Mapplethorpe's portraits -- made both of his own initiative and on commission -- bring to life the legendary cultural scene of New York in the late 1970s and 1980s and document several generations of influential creative personalities, from grande dame artist Louise Nevelson to punk poet and musician Patti Smith.

This exhibition presents exquisite black-and-white photographs of nearly one hundred artists, art dealers, writers, musicians, designers, dancers, actors, and actresses -- many of whom changed the course of literature, visual art, and music. Included are William Burroughs, Truman Capote, Glenn Close, Marianne Faithfull, Richard Gere, Keith Haring, David Hockney, Grace Jones, Lisette Model, Alice Neel, Yoko Ono, Paloma Picasso, Iggy Pop, Isabella Rossellini, Ed Ruscha, Arnold Schwarzenegger, and Andy Warhol. Many of the images are on loan from the Robert Mapplethorpe Foundation, New York.

Guest curator Gordon Baldwin notes that these portraits document a key moment in New York life and in the LGBT community: "Mapplethorpe's [portraits] are representative of New York at a particularly vibrant, prosperous, and expansive moment in its history, when it was the undisputed center of the art world, and before it experienced the full impact of the AIDS epidemic." This exhibition and the accompanying catalogue reveal Mapplethorpe's contribution to the history of photography and the evolution of the modern portrait.

This exhibition was organized by the Palm Springs Art Museum, Palm Springs, California, with the assistance of guest curator Gordon Baldwin. The exhibition is sponsored in part by the Helene and Lou Galen Exhibition Fund and the Faye and Herman Sarkowsky Exhibition Fund.

Sponsored by the SJMA Store Guild.

title: Limited Time Wine Specials
description:
Take advantage of some great wine deals over the next two months at The Grill on the Alley in downtown San Jose. Highlighting a variety of wines from the reputable Cain Vineyard & Winery, enjoy 4 different wines in our bar, dining room and patio area. This promotion will run for 2 months and feature the 2006 Cain Concept -'the Benchland' the NV7 Cain Cuvee, the 2002 Cain Concept - Library Edition, as well as the 2005 Cain Five - a true Bordeaux Blend!

-------------------------------------------------------
2006 Cain Concept "The Benchland" - originating from the classical 'benchlands' of Napa Valley on the eastern and western benches of Oakville, Rutherford and St. Helena. This wine has Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot for a strong backbone, along with Cabernet Franc for the nose and a touch of Merlot for a layer of velvet. Able to stand up to any steak, most notably the Tomahawk Rib Chop!

NV7 Cain Cuvee - a more sleek and approachable wine with fresh vibrancy, the NV Cain Cuvee is immediately delicious while showing great aging potential. Cabernet Franc contributes to the aromatic top, while the Merlot component lays down a silky base. We recommend pairing this with our Filet Mignon.

2002 Cain Concept "Library Edition" - this Cabernet Sauvignon based blend embodies lush fruit and supple tannins. It is ripe, plummy, rich and dusty, reflecting a long, warm summer in the Oakville and Rutherford districts of Napa Valley. Taste this with our Kansas City Bone-In New York Steak for perfect pairing.

2005 Cain Five - a true Bordeaux Blend with Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Expected to age gracefully for a long time, this wine opens well in the glass. With a fine touch of tannins and a focus on red cherries and exotic spices, this wine is a true gem. 22 months in barrel. Try it paired with our Tomahawk Rib Chop.

-------------------------------------------------------

Each one of these wines are distinct and delicious, complementing our Bone-In Steaks perfectly. Ask for a pairing recommendation or enjoy by itself!
